name: Crafts
description: Are you interested in attending or teaching arts and crafts classes? Become a member enjoy access to our classroom space and crafting resources!

benefits.title: Cricut Machines
benefits.description: Use our two Cricut machines to cut vinyl, paper, fabric, and more. Perfect for making custom decals, cards, and craft projects with precision and ease.

benefits.title: Crafting Supplies
benefits.description: Choose from a wide range of tools and supplies for cutting paper, painting, scrapbooking, leather work, button making, and rock tumbling.

benefits.title: Design Software
benefits.description: Work on our dedicated computer loaded with design software including PE Design for embroidery, Inkscape, and other creative tools for planning your projects.

benefits.title: Classroom Space
benefits.description: Host workshops, classes, and group projects in our crafts zone, which includes a large table and space for up to 15 attendees. Request a copy of our event form for booking details.
